title: IDKMesh Control Tower Run Response v0.1
description: The success envelope returned by `GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}`, wrapping the same idkmesh/product_spine_run_store.py:PersistedProductSpineRun.to_dict() shape the CLI's `idkmesh run status --json` already prints -- the HTTP read surface reuses the CLI's application service rather than defining a second one (docs/architecture/API_CONTROL_PLANE_ARCHITECTURE.md). `created` and `replayed` are always false for a read: they describe the outcome of a create call, carried over from the shared projection type rather than given a second one.
